final.title: Ready to take back control of your presence?
final.lead: Start your trial, or book a call: we look at your presence together and show you the tool on your own brand.

1.a: It's a communications agency, inside a piece of software. Our experts lay your brand's foundations — tone, editorial line, art direction — then the tool generates, schedules and publishes your content across your 6 networks (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X) and your Google listing. You approve, and you stay in control. The result: the consistency of an agency, for a fraction of the price, in a few hours a month.

2.q: Won't the content sound generic, like all AI?
2.a: That's the first worry, and it's a fair one. What makes the difference here is what happens before: our experts study your brand, your positioning and the way you speak, then calibrate the tool on YOU. So it doesn't come out as “an AI” — it comes out as your content, in your voice. That's exactly what sets Postorico apart from an off-the-shelf post generator.

3.q: Is it fully automatic? Does it publish on its own?
3.a: No, and that's deliberate. The tool does the heavy lifting: it generates your ideas, your copy, your visuals, your calendar. But nothing goes live without your approval. You read it, you adjust, you approve — only then does publishing happen automatically. It's your brand: you always keep your hands on it.

4.q: How much of my time does it take each month?
4.a: A few hours a month, once the system is in place. The tool prepares everything; you approve. You go from “I really should post” (never done) to “it's ready, I'll approve it”.

5.a: The subscription is €279 a month, all-inclusive, no commitment, with a 14-day trial. If you'd like experts to lay your brand's foundations before you publish, the Foundations Pack is €1,499, once — it's optional. Compare that to an agency, which typically bills €2,000 to €3,000 a month, forever.

6.q: What is the Foundations Pack for, if it's optional?
6.a: Saving time, and starting right. Our experts do genuine agency work: brand audit, tone of voice, editorial line, art direction, feed templates and custom carousels. That's what guarantees everything that follows looks like you, from day one. An agency would bill this at €3,000 or more — and keep billing you every month.

7.q: Can I start without the Foundations Pack?
7.a: Yes, and many do. You take the subscription alone and tune your brand yourself: the setup assistant asks the right questions and fills in your profile with you. The Pack is for those who'd rather delegate that groundwork.

8.q: I already have an apprentice running my networks. Is Postorico here to replace them?
8.a: No — it's here to free them up. An apprentice spending their days writing posts is wasted potential. With Postorico, the tool becomes the content machine (copy, visuals, volume, consistency), and your apprentice focuses on what a machine will never do: shooting reels, filming the field, capturing the real thing. The right team is both.

9.q: What happens the day the person running my networks leaves?
9.a: That's one of the biggest advantages. With Postorico, the strategy and the editorial line live in the system, not in one person's head. If someone leaves, your brand's presence doesn't move: the next person picks up with the same direction, the same voice, the same quality. No break.

10.q: Does it really handle my Google listing?
10.a: Yes, and it's too often overlooked. Your Google listing is frequently the first place a customer discovers you, before your website. Postorico feeds it regularly, like your networks, so you show up — and reassure — when someone searches for your service nearby.

11.q: Which networks does it work with?
11.a: LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and X — plus your Google Business Profile. All run from a single place, with content adapted to each platform.

12.q: I have several locations / several brands. Do you handle that?
12.a: Yes. We have a Multi-account offer, priced on request, built for networks, franchises and groups: one coherent brand rolled out across all your locations, each with its own networks and local Google listing, managed centrally. Tell us about your network and we'll build your quote.

13.a: With a call. We look at your current presence together, we show you the software on your own business, and we see whether Postorico is right for you. No pressure. Book your slot, we'll take care of the rest.
